responseText:
I can’t run in the background or proactively message you later — I don’t have the ability to keep working offline or push a notification after you leave. I can, however, either do the work now in this chat, or help you set up an automated reminder/message so you get pinged when the time is up. I’m happy to do whichever you prefer.

I’m not sure what “this” refers to (the task), how long “a few hours” is exactly, or which channel you want to be notified on. Please tell me:
- What work should be done during those hours? (describe the task)
- How long should I “take” (e.g., 2 hours, 3 hours)?
- When should I notify you (absolute time or “in X hours”)?
- How do you want to be notified (email, Slack, SMS, phone reminder, calendar notification)?
Once you answer, I can either do the work now and deliver results immediately, or
